Late in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stormhawk (Imperial I-class)|''Stormhawk'']] executed a hit-and-fade '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]], wiping out [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] personnel. The ''Stormhawk'' acted on the orders of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], who studied the New Republic's reaction to his recent attacks on the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] in order to determine their reaction patterns, and the Galactic Empire set up a listening post on Saarn.
